_comment: Sector key -> place name. Keys come from the plugin: Sector.GetIDString() when set, else the enum name, else the GameObject name (the usual case). The plugin records every sector entered to BepInEx/gcp-sectors-seen.json. This file is hot-reloaded, so no restart and no rebuild is needed. 'confirmed' is true when the name is certain, and false when the name is inferred from the sector id and still needs a check in game.
